title: Add tiered discounts and coupon stacking to the shop
prompt:
Product wants two pricing features in the shop package (see shop/). The existing tests in tests/ must keep passing unchanged; please add tests for the new behaviour too. All money is integer cents; "rounded" means half up to the cent (shop/money.py has helpers).

1. Tiered quantity discounts per category
- Add `TierRule(category, min_qty, percent)` (a frozen dataclass) to shop/models.py.
- `checkout(cart, customer, tier_rules=None)`: with `None`, use `shop.settings.DEFAULT_TIER_RULES`, which should be: books 5% off from 3 items and 10% off from 6 items; stationery 15% off from 10 items. Passing `[]` turns tiers off.
- For each category, add up the quantity of all cart lines in that category. The rule with the highest `min_qty` that the quantity reaches applies (rules can come in any order). Its percentage comes off every line in that category, rounded per line.

2. Coupon stacking
- `Coupon` gets a new field `exclusive: bool = False`.
- `cart.apply_coupon(coupon)` now adds a coupon instead of replacing the current one. `cart.coupons` is the list of applied coupons in the order they were applied. Add `cart.remove_coupon(code)` (CouponError if that code isn't applied); `clear_coupon()` removes all coupons.
- `apply_coupon` raises CouponError and leaves the cart unchanged when: the same code is already applied; it would be a second percent coupon; the new coupon is exclusive and other coupons are applied; or an exclusive coupon is already applied. Any number of fixed coupons can stack.
- At checkout every coupon's `min_subtotal_cents` is checked against the subtotal after tier discounts (not reduced by other coupons); coupons that miss their minimum are skipped. Then the percent coupon (if any) applies to the subtotal after tier discounts, then the fixed coupons in the order they were applied, each capped so the merchandise amount never goes below zero.

3. Order and receipt
- `Order` gets `tier_discount` (cents), `coupon_discount` (cents), `applied_coupons` (list of `(code, cents)` tuples in the order they were applied at checkout, i.e. the percent coupon first) and `rejected_coupons` (codes skipped for missing their minimum). `discount` remains the total discount (tier + coupons). Tax and shipping keep working as today, on the merchandise amount after all discounts.
- `format_receipt` shows a `Tier discount` row when there is a tier discount and one `Coupon <CODE>` row per applied coupon, with negative amounts formatted like the other rows (e.g. `-4.60`).
